main.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
main.DESIGN.md:
# Ledger App design system

## Color

Use the tokens in `app/ui/tokens.css`. Never write a hex value in a component or a view.

| Token | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `--accent` | Primary actions and links |
| `--danger` | Destructive actions and errors |
| `--text-muted` | Secondary text |
| `--surface` | Card and panel backgrounds |

## Spacing

Spacing comes from the 4px scale only: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32. Use the `gap-*` and `p-*` classes.

## Components

- `Button` in `app/ui/Button.tsx` is the only button. It has `primary`, `secondary`, and `danger` variants. Add a variant there before building another button.
- `Card` in `app/ui/Card.tsx` wraps every panel.

## Avoid

- Gradients and drop shadows on controls.
- Inline `style` attributes.

430.title: Highlight the recommended plan in the plan picker
430.body:
## Problem

Customers comparing plans cannot tell which one we recommend.

## Scope

Mark the recommended plan in the plan picker.

## Verification

- The recommended plan shows a "Recommended" badge, proven by a test.
- Before-and-after screenshots of the plan picker are attached.

Scores: impact 2, confidence 2, verification effort 3, undo cost 1.
